promotions.story: Some culinary journeys take you places without ever leaving the table. With Beloved Bihar, Guest Chef Shubhra Singh promises to take you on one such journey through her ancestral village Balua Deorhi. We look forward to hosting you at Kanak from 21 to 25 September 2026 for lunch & dinner.
promotions.full: Some culinary journeys take you places without ever leaving the table. With Beloved Bihar, Guest Chef Shubhra Singh promises to take you on one such journey through her ancestral village Balua Deorhi. Together with Chef Ananya Khare, Chef Shubra presents an heirloom menu shaped by the traditions of Bihar - from artisanal Katarni rice and hand-milled pulses to time-honoured preparations that have travelled across generations. An intimate five-day exploration of Bihar, its regional flavours and the stories held within its cuisine. 21–25 September 2026 Lunch | 12:30–3 PM Dinner | 7–11 PM 📍 Kanak
